licenses.rubrc: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (root, lib and page package.json; the repo carries no LICENSE file)
licenses.rustc_cargo_rust_analyzer_wasm: MIT OR Apache-2.0, inherited by the prebuilt rustc_opt.wasm / cargo_opt.wasm / lsp_opt.wasm
licenses.llvm_wasm: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception — llvm_opt.wasm is a build of LLVM
licenses.wasi_virt_layer_cli: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (LICENSE in the release tarball)
licenses.sysroot: MIT OR Apache-2.0 — a build of the rust standard library
licenses.note: `license` above is what dist/manifest.json reports for the package as a whole; the LLVM exception applies to the LLVM inside the composed component.

toolchain.note: wasm-opt >= 122 is required for --enable-shared-everything, so Binaryen is pinned to its own upstream release rather than taken from PATH or from the 0.116.1 that wasi_virt_layer vendors; the composition runs cargo on both the default and the nightly toolchain (-Zbuild-std=std,panic_unwind), so both need the wasm32-wasip1-threads target and nightly needs rust-src.
